review_response_tasks.rationale: B empty由nothing in it明示为空。E highest是比较高低而非内容物为空，C next to缺其后参照物，A cheap价格/D heavy重量都不表达当前没有物件；最佳项由紧接定义确定。
D heavy与not light重量反义直接对应。E highest说高度、B empty说是否装物、A cheap说价格，均不能表达题干不是轻这一重量要求；C next to缺后接参照物。
E highest在the和shelf之间修饰最高层，top shelf与above my head共同支持。B empty/A cheap/D heavy也可修饰货架但不表达top和above的层级；C next to不在这里作the后的这一最高层形容词。
C next to后接the door给空间关系，on left side进一步定位。E highest/B empty/A cheap/D heavy不能直接引出the door形成这里的完整系表位置结构。
A cheap对应No否定expensive并给仅两元的本情境价格评价。E highest高低/B empty空满/D heavy重量未回答贵不贵且不受价格说明支持；C next to缺参照物。

A. cheap
B. empty
C. next to
D. heavy

completed_passage:
Mia: Can I put these cups in this box?
Leo: Yes. The box is empty. There is nothing in it now.
Mia: Will it be easy to carry after we put all those cups inside?
Leo: No. It will be heavy, not light.
Mia: Can we put the full box on the top shelf?
Leo: No. The highest shelf is above my head. Use the bottom shelf instead.
Mia: Where is that bottom shelf?
Leo: It is next to the door, on the left side of the door.
Mia: Do we have to buy an expensive roll of tape?
Leo: No. This roll is cheap. It costs only two yuan.
